Backcountry turned a 200,000-product catalog into a growth lever.

For over 25 years, Backcountry has been the go-to retailer for outdoor enthusiasts seeking premium gear and apparel. From mountaineers to trail runners, the brand built loyalty through a curated mix of top outdoor labels.

With over 200,000 products across categories like bike, climb, ski, camping, and trail running, Backcountry's catalog is a major competitive advantage. It's also a personalization problem at a scale no team could solve manually. To realize conversion gains, Backcountry needed a way to learn from every shopper interaction and act on it across the full assortment.

The existing framework offered strong consistency but limited the flexibility to tailor layouts by category, price point, or shopper intent. Expanding dynamic options for bundles and complementary gear would better align with how customers actually shop. Doing it across 200,000 products was a non-starter without automation.

A full site rebuild would have introduced unnecessary risk and long timelines. Backcountry needed AI agents that could iterate continuously across the catalog while preserving the strengths of the existing foundation.
AI-generated page variations tailored by product type, intent, and traffic source

"At our scale, growth doesn't come from plug-and-play tools; it comes from innovation partners willing to build alongside you. FERMÀT has been exactly that for Backcountry, helping us create AI-driven and dynamic landing experiences for Google Shopping that reflect how our customers actually browse and buy across a massive catalog." - Kevin Lenau, President, Backcountry
Pro shoppers looking for fast access to specs and sizing nuance
Casual shoppers needing simple explanations and helpful product context

Designing experiences for each behavior helped Backcountry match the page to both the product and the shopper. FERMÀT didn't just fix a page template. It changed how Backcountry worked. Backcountry described FERMÀT as an innovation partner, not a plug-and-play tool.
1,000+ SKUs with increased add-to-cart rates. Continuous experimentation across five key categories. Marketing and merchandising in direct control of the experience layer.
Travelpro built a repeatable playbook to scale SMS into a revenue channel.
Challenge: turn SMS from a retention channel into a revenue engine.
Travelpro needed to transform SMS from a basic communication tool into a true performance marketing channel that could drive meaningful revenue.

Despite building a substantial SMS subscriber base, Travelpro faced the classic challenge of underutilized potential. SMS campaigns lacked dedicated experiences and strategic content, making continued investment hard to justify. To shift SMS from a retention tool into a high-impact revenue driver, the team needed to:
Build a scalable playbook for SKU-specific promos
With growing buzz around a new product line, Travelpro partnered with FERMÀT to turn SMS into a performance channel.

FERMÀT's AI agents built exclusive, high-converting SMS shopping experiences in hours, establishing a new performance marketing playbook. What began as a single test quickly evolved into a scalable channel strategy. Agents learned from subscriber behavior, ran tests across every drop, and scaled based on what worked.

SMS stopped being a basic communication tool and started behaving like a true performance channel. AI agents built the experience, ran the timing, attributed the revenue, and iterated for the next drop. Travelpro moved from one-off SMS sends to continuous, compounding revenue.
Travelpro launched a dedicated FERMÀT page with an SMS-only offer of roughly 30% off a featured product collection. The offer wasn't available anywhere else, creating true exclusivity and urgency.
SMS messages were precisely timed to follow two email sends from a major media outlet, positioning SMS as the final, high-intent touchpoint for already-engaged shoppers.
Dedicated FERMÀT pages let Travelpro isolate and measure SMS-driven traffic. For the first time, the team had true visibility into channel performance.
This strategic shift gave Travelpro exactly what they needed: speed, control, and measurable impact.
Approximately $25K in total revenue

Travelpro's FERMÀT-powered SMS campaign outperformed a million-subscriber email blast, proving SMS's potential as a primary revenue channel. With only 3.5% of the email campaign's reach, the SMS drop drove 13% more orders and a higher average order value, establishing SMS as a true revenue engine.

"It's given us an extra utility for our SMS platform. We can now say you're going to get a VIP-only offer via SMS, and that becomes a reason to subscribe. It's something we haven't been able to do before, and it's really powerful." Mark Costigliola, VP of Ecommerce, Travelpro

The campaign reshaped Travelpro's SMS strategy from a one-off test to a repeatable growth lever. Monthly SMS drops, AI agents iterating between each one, and compounding learning fueling both acquisition and revenue.
The marketing team needed three things that no point tool could deliver together:
GNC drives substantial paid traffic to product pages each month. The team needed those clicks to convert and a way to test the experience without pulling in engineering every time.

Generic, one-size-fits-all product pages couldn't differentiate by traffic source, intent, or audience segment. Running meaningful experiments across hundreds of thousands of SKUs required infrastructure that didn't yet exist.

GNC had no way of knowing whether its products appeared when consumers asked AI tools for supplement recommendations. AI-powered discovery is reshaping how people shop. That blind spot was a strategic risk the team couldn't afford to ignore.
